claim: Sorting the seat system's unnamed exports turns up values whose absence leaves a live path inert rather than unchanged. Three readers take a seat value nothing writes, a name claim's live-holder refusal fires on a rename and never on a start, the pending maintainer watches every store but the one it counts from, a factory sits beside the copy of itself that runs, and the only reader of a costly observation is reached by nothing. Each reads as a wire come loose rather than a road taken out on purpose, so each is left rather than ablated.

evidence:
Found 2026-09-13 while sorting every `agent/` export the no-unused-exports check refuses. Each was established by reading the code as it is rather than its history: `git log -S` is refused by `block-history-search`.

THE ROTATED SESSION. `agent/seat/session/modules/seat-rotated-session/seat-rotated-session.module.code.ts:22` `keepRotated` is the only writer of `rotated-session-uuid` in the tree. Three live paths read it: `seat-page-beat.module.code.ts:94`, `seat-stated.module.code.ts:77` and `supervisor-clear-rebind-wire.module.code.ts:35`, while `supervisor-heartbeat-beat.module.code.ts:135` clears it. Read by three, cleared by one, written by none.

THE NAME CLAIM. `agent/seat/name-claiming/modules/seat-name-claim/seat-name-claim.module.code.ts:79` refuses a claim only where the holder reads as present, and `agent-name-bind.module.code.ts:52` reads that presence as unknown unless a caller hands one in. `seat-name-restate.module.code.ts:42` is the one caller that hands one in. `run-supervisor.module.code.ts:13` and the three callers of `mintNamedAgent` hand none, though `seat-name-bind.module.code.ts:23` already holds the seat whose presence they would hand in. So the refusal fires on a rename and never on a start.

THE UNWATCHED STORE. `pending-maintaining.module.code.ts:29-31` watches the seats folder and the messages folder. `pendingFromFiles` counts its live-subagent component off the subagent census, and `agent/subagent/modules/page-akasha/subagent-page-akasha.module.code.ts:17` `akashaSubagentsDirIn` is the call the watch list does not make.

THE FACTORY BESIDE ITS COPY. `agent/seat/reviving/modules/resume-verify/resume-verify.module.code.ts:34` `liveResumeVerifyDeps` builds an object `seat-resume.module.code.ts:157-163` builds inline, importing `liveResumeVerifySleep` from that same module to fill one field.

THE COSTLY OBSERVATION. `supervisor-idle-decide.module.code.ts:8` `isIdle` is the one member of that file the idle rule surface does not carry, and the only reader of the in-flight dispatch children `supervisor-idle-observe.module.code.ts:135-149` gathers on every run by walking every seat page.

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR SORTING. The test telling a road taken out from a wire come loose was going to be history: whether a landing said the removal was meant. That test is gone. What takes its place reads better anyway, which is to ask what a live path expects. A value whose absence leaves a reader reading nothing, a drain draining nothing, or a refusal that cannot fire is a repair. A value whose absence leaves every remaining path doing exactly what it does now is an ablation.

NOT ESTABLISHED. Nothing here was run. Whether any of these was left half-wired on purpose is not recovered; no page and no commit message says.
